bullets: • SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund carries an exit load of 0%, meaning no exit load fee is charged upon redemption from this scheme.
• However, SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund enforces a mandatory 3-year lock-in period, during which units cannot be redeemed at all, regardless of exit load.
• The expense ratio for SBI Large Cap Fund Direct Plan typically ranges between 0.5% and 0.9% per annum, which is deducted from the fund's Net Asset Value (NAV).
• Regular plans of SBI Mutual Fund schemes carry a higher expense ratio compared to direct plans, as they include distributor commission within the Total Expense Ratio (TER).
• A Securities Transaction Tax (STT) of 0.001% is applicable on equity mutual fund redemptions, as mandated by the government, and is separate from any exit load or expense ratio.
• SEBI mandates full disclosure of the Total Expense Ratio (TER) for all mutual fund schemes, ensuring transparency for investors across all SBI Mutual Fund products.
